the stat change is not a decrease to accuracy, or was self-inflicted

verified via Showdown source: Illuminate was changed (Gen 9) from a purely cosmetic/informational ability to a real in-battle effect identical to Keen Eye/Big Pecks — onTryBoost blocks the holder's own accuracy from being lowered by others, and onModifyMove sets move.ignoreEvasion = true unconditionally. Corrected from a prior entry that (correctly, for older gens) described it as having no in-battle effect; modern-mainline data now needs both blocks.
